subject.title: fix(ui): keep custodian transcript aligned after inference errors

question: Should the structured session-invalidated Gateway error detail be accepted as the permanent client contract for Custodian recovery?
rationale: The PR introduces a protocol-visible error detail and changes live-session recovery semantics; the supplied mock evidence does not establish the real runtime behavior, and the protected maintainer label requires human handling.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Confirm the error-detail contract after reviewing a redacted real-Gateway recovery trace.

options.title: Narrow or redesign the contract
options.body: Keep the PR paused if the Gateway marker should remain internal or a different session-recovery contract is preferred.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the error-detail contract after reviewing a redacted real-Gateway recovery trace.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Gateway and Custodian lifecycle changes and can provide the behavior and proof context.
